title: The three-finger salute.
description:
The three-finger salute.

It was a private developer tool. Rebooting IBM's prototype PC meant sitting through memory tests on every restart. The team hunting bugs rebooted every five minutes. One of them got tired of waiting.

The 12th of 12 engineers on the secret PC project in Boca Raton. His instant-reboot shortcut took five or ten minutes, one item on a list of a hundred tasks.

One hand cannot press them. Del sat across the keyboard from Ctrl and Alt, so no accident could trigger it. The public only found out because IBM printed it in the technical manual.

I may have invented it, but Bill made it famous.
